nodes.name: Self-terminated Pt electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Pt300/CP was fabricated by direct self-terminated electrodeposition (SED) on carbon paper (CP). By applying a repeated potential pulse: (0.4 VSCE for 2 s) + (-0.9 VSCE for 10 s) + (0.4 VSCE for 3 s), 300 cycles from 3 mM K2PtCl4 + 0.5 M NaCl electrolyte.
nodes.source_text: Kim et al. fabricated an extremely low-loading Pt catalyst on carbon paper (CP) by direct self-terminated electrodeposition (SED)... Pulse: (0.4 VSCE for 2 s) + (-0.9 VSCE for 10 s) + (0.4 VSCE for 3 s), 300 cycles

nodes.name: Pt-MoSx hybrid electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Pt1.8MoS2 was fabricated by electrodeposition at constant potential of -1.3 VAg/AgCl for 10 min from 10 mM (NH4)2MoS4 + 0.2 M KCl + 6.4 mM Pt precursor electrolyte on glassy carbon substrate.

nodes.name: CoRe alloy electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: CoRe/CP was fabricated by electrodeposition at -1.5 VSCE for 600 s from 10 mM CoSO4·7H2O + 0~5 mM NH4ReO4 + 100 mM Na3C6H5O7 + (NH4)2SO4 electrolyte on carbon paper.
nodes.source_text: Kim et al. reported a CoRe alloy catalyst for CP by electrodeposition... -1.5 VSCE for 600 s from 10 mM CoSO4·7H2O + 0~5 mM NH4ReO4+ 100 mM Na3C6H5O7+ (NH4)2SO4
Pt/CP with a pulse number of 300 exhibited the highest HER activity with an overpotential of 45 mV at -10 mA cm-2 and a Tafel slope of 36 mV dec-1 in 0.5 M H2SO4 electrolyte. Pt:0.021 mgPt cm-2
Pt1.8MoS2 showed HER kinetics comparable to those of electrodeposited Pt. From the Tafel slope... All the Pt-MoSx hybrid catalysts demonstrated a lower HER overpotential and Tafel slope than MoS2.
the optimized CoRe/CP electrode exhibited higher HER activity with an overpotential of 45.1 mV at -10 mA cm-2
